authority: Mission instruction to apply the already-governed V1 promotion gate to the real 20-item result without changing thresholds.

consequences.nextJustifiedAction: The governed 560-row EXP-002 production run is the evidence-supported next step, but it requires explicit authorization and was NOT launched.

decision: Record that the GHARIBO EXP-002 pilot adapter (sha256 8d80d7ca...) FAILED the governed V1 qualification gate on the frozen 20-item subset and is NOT promoted. GHARIBO V1 is NOT created. The gate thresholds were not changed. No item was replaced. No retraining was performed and the 560-row production run was NOT launched. The result is model-quality insufficiency: 13/20 predictions fail the required schema, valid_records is 0/20, and the adapter emits `payload` where the contract requires `normalizedPayload` while omitting `classification`.

diagnosis.note: An initial scoring pass was invalid because the gold was passed in the wrong shape; it was corrected BEFORE any conclusion was drawn and was never reported as a model failure.

qualification.evidenceStrength: 20 items, NOT equivalent to 80 (DEC-0057 evidence-budget reduction)
